study_design: Population-based case-control study using prospectively collected questionnaire exposure data
cohort_total_n_excerpt: By linking the Swedish Cancer Registry with the Swedish Twin Registry 406 cases of prostate cancer were selected from the twin register. As controls 1,218 men without prostate cancer were randomly selected from the same register.
reason: The abstract evaluates overall prostate cancer risk in a population-based case-control study. It does not analyze high-grade, advanced, metastatic, lethal, or otherwise aggressive incident prostate cancer.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: All specific food items studied, as well as tobacco and alcohol consumption, were unrelated to prostate cancer risk.
